faqs.q: Where and how are the Enerpac bar cutters used?
faqs.a: Enerpac bar cutters shear steel bar, flat bar and rebar in cordless, electric and flat-bar versions. The listing has 12 models from 50 to 121 ton, with material diameters such as 0.87 in and 1.02 in on the electric cutters. This listing carries 12 part numbers.

faqs.q: Which sizes are the Enerpac bar cutters available in?
faqs.a: The listing carries 12 part numbers, such as EBC20B for a cordless bar cutter, EBE22E and EBE26E for 230V electric cutter bars and EFBE5017E and EFBE7015E for 230V electric flat bar cutters. Each states a capacity from 50 to 121 ton or a material diameter.

faqs.q: How should I select the Enerpac bar cutters for my application?
faqs.a: Choose on the material and the maximum diameter the cutter is rated to cut, which the item name states, for example 0.87 in for the EBE-22E and 1.02 in for the EBE-26E. Then choose cordless or 230V electric, and bar or flat bar.

faqs.q: What working pressure applies to the Enerpac bar cutters?
faqs.a: The size table states each model's capacity in tons for the Enerpac bar cutters, and cutting capacity depends on the material and diameter you are cutting. Choose a cutter on the material and maximum diameter it is rated to cut, and never cut harder or larger material than the model's rating.

faqs.q: Which materials are the Enerpac bar cutters offered in?
faqs.a: The listing does not state the blade material of the Enerpac bar cutters. Cutter blades are hardened tool steel, so the material and size you cut set the choice; tell us what you will cut and we check it with the maker.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the Enerpac bar cutters?
faqs.a: The listing names no ISO, ASME or EN standard for the Enerpac bar cutters and holds no certificates. If your site requires a test certificate or a safety document, say so in the enquiry and we ask the maker what it can issue.

faqs.q: Which parts do the Enerpac bar cutters mate with?
faqs.a: The Enerpac bar cutters run from a hydraulic pump or is self-contained, according to the model, and uses blades matched to the material it cuts. Check whether the model you want is a cutter head that needs a pump or a self-contained set.

faqs.q: How should the Enerpac bar cutters be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: Check the blades of the Enerpac bar cutters for chips and wear before each job, keep the cutter square to the work and stay clear of the cutting zone and any flying offcut. Use the cutter only on the material and size it is rated for.

faqs.q: Which industries and jobs use the Enerpac bar cutters?
faqs.a: The Enerpac bar cutters are used for cutting bar, chain, wire, cable, pipe and structural steel in demolition, rescue, mining, marine and maintenance jobs where a hydraulic cut is safer than a torch.

faqs.q: How do the Enerpac bar cutters differ from the Enerpac chain, wire and cable cutters?
faqs.a: The bar cutters are rated 50 to 121 ton for steel bar and flat bar, while [the Enerpac chain, wire and cable cutters](/p/enerpac-chain-wire-and-cable-cutters) are rated 35.1 to 89 ton for chain, wire and cable. Choose by the material you cut, because blade shape differs.

faqs.q: What country of origin and HS code apply to the Enerpac bar cutters?
faqs.a: We ship the Enerpac bar cutters from our Dubai, UAE warehouse to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. The country of origin depends on the plant that made the batch and is stated on the commercial invoice. Export documents come with the order; ask on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Can I buy the Enerpac bar cutters from stock in the UAE?
faqs.a: Yes, the Enerpac bar cutters are held in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and we ship worldwide with the best lead times. Quote the part numbers you need on [our contact page](/contact).
